overview: The paper proposes Cross-Timestep, a 3D diffusion framework for robust medical image segmentation that resolves initial-stage collapse via an Adaptive Priori Decoding Strategy (APDS) and ensures temporal coherence using trans-temporal memory LSTM (tLSTM) variants.

modules.name: Multi-Center Data Preprocessing and Loading
modules.description: Handles loading of 3D medical volumes (CT/MRI) from multi-center datasets (LNCTVSeg, OAseg), including format parsing, voxel resampling, intensity normalization, and extraction of random 3D patches for training, while ensuring distinct domain information is preserved for cross-center evaluation.

modules.name: 3D Data Augmentation Pipeline
modules.description: Implements specific on-the-fly 3D spatial and intensity augmentations to improve robustness, including random rotation, random scaling, random elastic deformation, random gamma correction, and random flipping.

modules.name: Forward Diffusion Process Scheduler
modules.description: Defines the fixed Markov chain for the forward diffusion process, managing the predefined variance schedule to progressively add Gaussian noise to the ground truth segmentation masks over a sequence of timesteps until reaching isotropic noise.

modules.name: Adaptive Priori Decoding Strategy (APDS)
modules.description: Implements the APDS module operating on the conditional branch, utilizing a Prior Decoder to generate a coarse structural prior from the conditional image, and applying a Reverse Addition (RA) mechanism with a time-dependent weighting factor that decays as timesteps decrease, providing stable scaffolding during high-noise stages without over-constraining refinement stages.

modules.name: Trans-Temporal Memory Units (Conv-tLSTM & Linear-tGRU)
modules.description: Implements the core recurrent cells with time-aware modulation. Conv-tLSTM replaces standard matrix multiplications with 3D convolutions in LSTM gates and maintains full 3D tensor memory. Linear-tGRU provides a lightweight alternative using linear transformations in a GRU structure to reduce computational overhead while preserving cross-timestep state.

modules.name: Spatial-Channel Trans-Temporal Memory (SC-tLSTM)
modules.description: Constructs a stateful spatial-channel attention mechanism utilizing the recurrent units. It processes spatial summaries using Conv-tLSTM for spatial attention and channel descriptors using Linear-tGRU for channel attention, enabling dynamic, temporally-aware feature refinement.

modules.name: Frequency Domain Trans-Temporal Memory (FFT-tLSTM)
modules.description: Implements frequency-domain denoising by transforming inputs using 3D FFT, filtering the fused noisy and conditional spectra through a recurrent block, modulating the output via the conditional spectrum, and mapping back to the spatial domain via inverse FFT with a residual connection.

modules.name: Cross-Timestep Network Architecture
modules.description: Assembles the main denoising network integrating an encoder utilizing FFT-tLSTM and SC-tLSTM, and a decoder utilizing SC-tLSTM stabilized by the APDS module. Manages the flow of noisy masks, conditional images, timestep embeddings, and cross-timestep recurrent states.

modules.name: Training and Optimization Engine
modules.description: Manages the DDPM training loop, computing the simplified noise prediction loss. Configures the AdamW optimizer, cosine annealing learning rate scheduler with warmup, and handles multi-GPU distributed data parallel training to optimize the network parameters.

modules.name: Reverse Diffusion and Stateful Inference Sampler
modules.description: Implements the iterative reverse sampling process starting from pure Gaussian noise. Manages the update and propagation of cross-timestep states through the tLSTM modules at each denoising step, generating progressively cleaner segmentation masks.

modules.name: Segmentation Evaluation Metrics Calculator
modules.description: Computes standard volumetric segmentation metrics to assess performance, including Dice Similarity Coefficient, Intersection over Union (IoU), and 95th percentile Hausdorff Distance (HD95).

modules.name: Initial-Stage Collapse Analyzer
modules.description: Implements the experimental logic to diagnose and evaluate initial-stage collapse by initiating the reverse diffusion process from varying noise levels and tracking the degradation of segmentation accuracy at high-noise timesteps.

modules.name: Computational Cost Profiler
modules.description: Profiles and logs the computational efficiency of the model, tracking metrics such as training duration, inference latency per volume, floating-point operations, and peak GPU memory consumption for comparison against baseline architectures.

modules.name: Visualization and Temporal Heatmap Generator
modules.description: Generates qualitative evaluations including spatial overlays of segmentation predictions, visualization of the APDS vs. Main decoder outputs across timesteps, and feature heatmap extraction from tLSTM modules to demonstrate progressive attention refinement.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration and Ablation Runner
modules.description: Provides a structured framework to define and execute ablation studies (e.g., isolating APDS, tLSTM, SC, FFT components), configure multi-center cross-dataset validation, and run sensitivity analyses on the number of diffusion sampling steps.
